sources.label: Wikipedia, "TOI-2136 b"
sources.quote: TOI-2136 b is a sub-Neptune exoplanet orbiting the nearby red dwarf star TOI-2136.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around TOI-2136. Its orbit and size follow Gan et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "TOI-2136 b"
sources.quote: It was discovered in 2022 through transit observations by NASA's TESS and independently validated using ground-based photometry and radial velocity measurements.
